description: Turns a rising voltage into four overlapping triangles, one after another, for crossfading a mixer between up to four signals; a VCV Rack version of the Doepfer A-144

params.text: Sets how much of the CV input drives the morph and in which direction, from full inversion through nothing to full
Sets the morph position by hand, 0V to 10V; the CV input is added to it

inputs.text: Drives the morph position, scaled by the CV amount knob and added to the MORPH knob

outputs.text: Rises from 0V to 10V as the morph position goes from 0V to 2V, then falls back to 0V by the time it reaches 4V
Stays at 0V until the morph position reaches 2V, peaks at 10V when it reaches 4V, and is back at 0V by 6V
Stays at 0V until the morph position reaches 4V, peaks at 10V when it reaches 6V, and is back at 0V by 8V
Stays at 0V until the morph position reaches 6V, peaks at 10V when it reaches 8V, and is back at 0V by 10V

notes: the input is not restricted to ramps; feeding it other shapes gives other wave shaping effects
this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and every output carries a single channel
